[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Fix iOS empty-body Edgar upload on report_inventory_movement.html (dapp)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dapp_beta/pull/98
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/ecosystem_change_logs/blob/main/deploys/entries/deploy_20260914T225739Z_dapp-prod.md
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/ecosystem_change_logs/blob/main/deploys/entries/deploy_20260914T230007Z_dapp-prod.md
  
  Details:
  Diagnosed and fixed the iOS WebKit empty-body upload bug on the DApp inventory-movement reporter.
  
  ROOT CAUSE: report_inventory_movement.html was the one signed-report form missed by PR #88 (2026-09-12), which only patched report_contribution, report_dao_expenses, and report_asset_receipt. The inventory-movement page still used the pre-#88 fetch()+FormData path; on iOS that POST intermittently goes out with an EMPTY body, while Edgar still answers HTTP 200 — so the old `if (!resp.ok)` check reported success while the ledger recorded a "[No Text Provided]" Inventory Movement row with signature_verification: no_signature_format and no attachment. Two call sites: single report submit and the batch submit loop.
  
  FIX (dapp_beta PR #98, squash-merged commit 7c0c48e):
  - Load shared scripts/edgar_submission.js; single report now uses EdgarSubmission.toSendableBlob(file) + submitWithRetry(...) (XHR transport, in-memory attachment, retries until Edgar confirms signature_verification: success).
  - Batch submit now counts a success only via EdgarSubmission.isDelivered(result).
  - service-worker.js cache bumped v20 -> v21.
  - New tests/report-forms-edgar.test.js asserting all four signed-report forms use the helper and no longer POST raw FormData; wired into npm run test:unit.
  - Local suite green: report-forms-edgar 16/0, expense 54/0, currencies 6/0, asset-receipt 18/0, edgar-submission 15/0.
  
  PROMOTION + VERIFICATION: sync_beta_to_prod(dapp_prod) reconciled (merge_type none — prod already carried 7c0c48e via upstream merge; no force). Prod live verified on dapp.truesight.me: page serves EdgarSubmission path (4 refs), service-worker cache v21, 0 remaining raw-FormData POSTs.
  
  OPEN FOLLOW-UP (deferred from #88, not yet actioned): server-side guard in dao_protocol so submit_contribution returns 400 on empty text / missing signature format, making it impossible for any client to have an empty body recorded as success.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
